verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an 'API and MCP' area where scoped service keys let scripts and automation interact with a workspace, so it has a first-party programmatic interface. Nothing shows that interface can push evidence or test results from uncatalogued systems, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented evidence/test-result upload endpoints, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, custom-integration guides, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build private/custom integrations against a documented API to push evidence and test results from systems the catalog doesn't cover

citations.quote: Use **service keys** for AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace.
Grant Full access to all tenant service-key scopes, or choose Limit access to… to grant only specific scopes.
